## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix/*`)
- [ ] New feature (`feature/*`)
- [ ] Hotfix (`hotfix/*`)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] This PR targets `develop` (or `main` for a hotfix)
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo build --release` succeeds
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md` / `README.fr.md`) if behavior changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased**
- [ ] No secrets committed (no `rustedin.json`, tokens, or client secrets)
